pages.text: A Storage Analyzer allows networks to see items in physical storage, things like chests, barrels and other inventories.$(br2)If you place one against an Era 1 Receiving Station, an analyzer is able to see the full network as known by the Tabulator Machine.$(br2)The Terminal will show these

items as a faded item with a blue lens icon, The lens button beside the terminal's search bar allows customization of how they're displayed.$(br2)If you click an analyzed item in the terminal, you can request it to be imported into the network, if it's connected to a Pneumatic Network, it passes the request to the Receiving Station, and the analyzer will then wait for the requested items and import them as they arrive.
Right-click an analyzer to configure how crafting plans use it.
